title: Falco
description: Runtime security: syscall rules matched on every node and container.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" | priority=~"Emergency|Alert|Critical" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" | priority="Error" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" | priority="Warning" [$__range])) or vector(0)
count(up{job="falco"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Kernel drops
panels.description: Syscall events dropped by the driver. Drops mean Falco may miss events.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(falcosecurity_scap_n_drops_total{node=~"$node"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(falcosecurity_scap_n_evts_total{node=~"$node"}[5m])), 1)
sum by (priority) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" [$__auto]))
sum by (rule) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" [$__auto]))

panels.title: MITRE ATT&CK tactics
panels.description: First MITRE tactic tag on each event.

targets.expr: sum by (tactic) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" |~ "(?i)$search" | regexp `"(?P<tactic>mitre_[a-z_]+)"` | tactic!="" [$__range]))
sum by (node) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Rule matches (Prometheus counter)
panels.description: Same events from the metrics endpoint; survives Loki retention.

targets.expr: sum by (rule_name) (increase(falcosecurity_falco_rules_matches_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
topk(20, sum by (rule, priority) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top containers
panels.description: host means the event came from the host, outside any container.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (output_fields_container_name, output_fields_container_image_repository) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" [$__range])))
topk(20, sum by (output_fields_proc_name, output_fields_user_name) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" [$__range])))

topk(20, sum by (output_fields_fd_name, rule) (count_over_time({task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" | output_fields_fd_name!="" [$__range])))
sum by (node) (rate(falcosecurity_scap_n_evts_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (node) (rate(falcosecurity_scap_n_drops_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
falcosecurity_falco_cpu_usage_ratio{node=~"$node"} * 100
falcosecurity_falco_memory_rss_bytes{node=~"$node"}

panels.title: Falco events
panels.description: Expand a line for container, process, user and file fields.

targets.expr: {task="falco", node=~"$node"} != "Falco internal" | json | __error__="" | rule!="" |~ "(?i)$search" | line_format "{{.priority}} {{.rule}} | {{.output}}"
